note: Registry of the intelligence-layer sources (phase 2). Same fields as rules/sources.json plus pit_field, pit_trusted (publication time trustworthy and never revised, so backfilled history may be used for labelled technical rehearsals), rate_limit, terms_checked_on and the env_key the adapter needs. Raw data stays in the private archive; the public repository only holds code, hashes and derived scores.

sources.data: company QID, English article, CEO, chairperson, country, industry; heads of state/government; central bank heads
sources.pit_field: our snapshot time (Wikidata history is not a clean as-known record)
sources.rate_limit: 2 queries per night; endpoint limit 60 s query time per minute
sources.terms: Structured data CC0; declared User-Agent required.
sources.contact_required: Wikimedia User-Agent policy: include a URL or email to reach the operator (we send the repository URL; ARENA_CONTACT adds the project email).

sources.provider: U.S. SEC EDGAR (submissions JSON, Form 4 XML)
sources.data: filings of universe companies: 8-K items, 10-K/10-Q, Form 4 insider trades, Form 144, 13D
sources.rate_limit: max 10 requests/s with a declared User-Agent (we use <7/s)
sources.terms: Public U.S. government information; SEC fair access policy (declared User-Agent, rate limit).
sources.contact_required: SEC asks for a User-Agent with a real contact email (www.sec.gov answers 403 'undeclared automated tool' otherwise; data.sec.gov is more lenient). Set ARENA_CONTACT to the project email.

sources.data: point-in-time fundamentals (revenue, earnings, cash flow, balance sheet, shares) per filing
sources.pit_field: filed date (+ acceptance time of the accession when known)
sources.contact_required: SEC asks for a User-Agent with a real contact email (www.sec.gov answers 403 'undeclared automated tool' otherwise; data.sec.gov is more lenient). Set ARENA_CONTACT to the project email.

sources.provider: U.S. Department of the Treasury, daily par yield curve (XML)
sources.pit_field: date (published after the close, ~18:00 New York)
sources.rate_limit: none published (1 request per month of data)

sources.provider: European Central Bank Data Portal (€STR, Euribor monthly, FX reference rates)
sources.data: €STR daily, Euribor 1m/3m/6m/12m monthly averages, EUR FX reference rates
sources.pit_field: €STR D+1 08:00 CET; FX D 16:00 CET; monthly 5th of next month
sources.terms: Public official statistics; reuse allowed with source attribution.
sources.attribution: Source: ECB statistics. Euribor is third-party data (EMMI) and is not covered by the ECB free-reuse rule: kept private, only derived figures shown.

sources.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED/ALFRED API
sources.credentials: free API key in the GitHub secret FRED_KEY
sources.data: 20 macro series with all vintages (CPI, PCE, payrolls, unemployment, claims, GDP, rates, spreads, dollar, oil, NFCI, balance sheet, M2); release calendar 3 weeks ahead
sources.rate_limit: no published number; ~22 requests per night
sources.terms: Free API key; required notice 'This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.'; copyrighted series need the owner's permission beyond personal use; do not replicate FRED.
sources.use: personal (copyrighted series excluded from public display)
sources.redistribution: derived figures with the FRED notice

sources.provider: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics API v2 and Bureau of Economic Analysis API
sources.credentials: optional BLS_KEY; BEA_KEY needed for BEA
sources.data: CPI, core CPI, payrolls, unemployment, hourly earnings, PPI, job openings; real GDP and consumption (BEA)
sources.pit_field: first time we saw the value (APIs carry no release time)
sources.terms: Public U.S. government data. BLS: cite retrieval date and the BLS disclaimer. BEA: cite BEA.

sources.provider: Federal Reserve and ECB RSS feeds
sources.data: press releases, statements, speeches, publications (titles and links)
sources.terms: Fed: public domain U.S. government content. ECB: reuse with attribution.
sources.license: Public domain (Fed); ECB copyright with reuse permitted (attribution)

sources.provider: Federal Register API v1 (National Archives / GPO)
sources.data: rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents; Public Inspection desk
sources.pit_field: publication date 06:00 New York; public inspection filed_at
sources.terms: Public domain U.S. government information; API free without key.

sources.provider: Wikimedia REST pageviews + Wikipedia Current Events portal
sources.data: daily English Wikipedia pageviews per company; curated daily world events
sources.pit_field: pageviews D -> D+1 12:00 UTC (never revised); portal = our fetch time
sources.terms: Pageviews CC0; portal text CC BY-SA 4.0 (kept private); declared User-Agent required.
sources.redistribution: pageview figures allowed; text with attribution
sources.contact_required: Wikimedia User-Agent policy: include a URL or email to reach the operator (we send the repository URL; ARENA_CONTACT adds the project email).

sources.provider: Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives, financial disclosure index and PTR PDFs
sources.data: members' periodic transaction reports: universe stock trades (buy/sell, amount range, trade date)
sources.pit_field: filing date (date only) -> next business day 06:00 New York, or first sighting if earlier
sources.rate_limit: none stated; 1 index + new PDFs per night
sources.terms: 5 U.S.C. 13107: unlawful to use for any commercial purpose (news media excepted), for credit ratings or for soliciting money. Personal, non-commercial research only.
sources.license: public record with statutory use restrictions
sources.use: non-commercial only (legal review before any product)

sources.provider: The GDELT Project 2.0 (event files and DOC API)
sources.data: daily per-country event counts, material-conflict share, Goldstein and tone; English news titles about universe companies
sources.rate_limit: files unlimited; DOC API 1 request per 5 s
sources.terms: Unlimited and unrestricted use for academic, commercial or governmental use; cite the GDELT Project and link to gdeltproject.org.
sources.raw_policy: 15-minute files kept by reference (permanent public URL + SHA-256); aggregates and DOC answers archived

sources.provider: Geopolitical Risk index (Caldara & Iacoviello) and Economic Policy Uncertainty (Baker, Bloom & Davis)
sources.data: daily GPR (total, acts, threats); daily US EPU
sources.pit_field: our nightly vintages (both series are revised)
sources.terms: CC BY (GPR) and CC BY 4.0 (EPU): cite the authors.

sources.provider: FDA press RSS, openFDA drug enforcement, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
sources.data: FDA press releases; drug recalls by universe firms; phase 2/3 trial updates sponsored by universe health companies
sources.pit_field: RSS pubDate; recall report_date 18:00 New York; trial last update + 1 day 06:00 New York
sources.terms: openFDA CC0 (credit: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration); FDA content public domain; ClinicalTrials.gov public NLM data.

sources.provider: Hacker News (Algolia search API) and Bluesky Jetstream (public firehose)
sources.data: HN stories mentioning universe companies; nightly 5-minute Bluesky sample of $CASHTAG post counts
sources.terms: HN API MIT-licensed; Bluesky developer guidelines: honour deletions (we store counts only, never text).
sources.license: MIT (HN API); Bluesky public data under its guidelines

sources.provider: FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume files
sources.data: daily short volume / total volume per symbol (consolidated NMS)
sources.pit_field: file date, posted the evening of D (18:00 New York)
sources.terms: FINRA data free for personal use with attribution; raw files not redistributed.
sources.excluded_reason: FINRA website terms (checked 2026-11-14) prohibit robots/scraping, building a database from the site and any use with machine learning or predictive analytics. Re-enable only with FINRA's written permission or a licensed feed.

sources.provider: Cboe daily market statistics (put/call) and VIX-family history CSV
sources.data: total/index/equity/SPX/VIX put-call ratios; VIX, VIX9D, VIX3M, VVIX closes
sources.pit_field: date, after the close (18:00 New York)
sources.terms: Cboe website content: personal, non-commercial use; no redistribution.
sources.use: not permitted (AI use needs a licence)
sources.excluded_reason: Cboe website terms allow personal non-commercial use only, and a January 2026 Cboe notice requires a licence to use Cboe data in or with AI. The put/call CSV history is frozen since 2019-10-04; current figures exist only in an undocumented JSON. Excluded until licensed.

sources.provider: S&P Dow Jones Indices index announcements
sources.excluded_reason: Checked 2026-11-14: robots.txt and pages answer 403 to declared bots and there is no official feed. Index changes are taken from 8-K filings and company press releases instead.

Checked 2026-11-14: Akamai answers 403 to declared bots and searching needs a click-through agreement (5 U.S.C. 13107). Not automatable without a person accepting it; out of scope until a licensed or official bulk source exists.
sources.terms: 5 U.S.C. 13107: no commercial use, no credit rating, no soliciting.
